Contribution timing: the annual engine credits a year's 401(k) contributions before that year's growth. Had the same contributions arrived monthly, the 2025 401(k) statement would read $476,693.08, +2.12% against the simulated balance: the size of the timing convention a backtest against real statements should expect (a monthly engine, Plan 32, is meant to remove it).
